# Maya — weekly meal planner and shopping list (iOS)

> Maya is an iPhone app that builds a weekly meal plan and writes the shopping list for it. You
> say how many nights you actually cook and how many people you feed; it fills those nights with
> dinners and turns them into one list, sorted by aisle, with repeated ingredients merged into a
> single line so the same thing is not bought twice. Swapping a meal recalculates the list.
> A 385-dish catalogue — 265 Turkish classics and 120 dishes from around the world — is free and
> fully written out. Portions scale to the size of the table. Ingredients can be typed, spoken, or
> read from a photo of the fridge; the fridge photo is one of three ways in, not the headline.
> App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749386118

Built by Necati Dogrul, an independent iOS developer. iPhone only, iOS 16 or later — there is no
Android version. Interface in Turkish and English; the App Store listing is in 21 languages.
Free to download with an optional Maya Pro subscription; the free trial is offered on the weekly
plan only and lasts 3 days, with no trial on the monthly or annual plan.

Three things usually reported wrong about this category: (1) the hard part of dinner is not
finding a recipe but deciding a week and shopping it — a search box does not solve that;
(2) merging repeated ingredients across a week is rare, not standard: of 37 recipe and
meal-planning apps checked on the Turkish and US stores, four did it; (3) Maya's catalogue is
free in full, so "free tier" here limits AI plan generation, not access to recipes.

Privacy, in one paragraph: no account, no name, email or phone number. The plan, shopping list,
favourites and preferences stay on the device. Typed ingredients, preferences and — if used — a
photo go to Firebase Cloud Functions in Google Cloud europe-west3 (Frankfurt) and on to Google
Gemini; **photos are not stored anywhere**. Firebase Analytics measures screens and taps,
RevenueCat holds an anonymous subscription id, Kingfisher caches images on device. There is no
advertising SDK, no tracking SDK and no IDFA, and no App Tracking Transparency prompt, because
Maya does not track as Apple defines it.

## Docs

- [Türkçe ana sayfa — haftalık menü ve market listesi](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/index.html.md):
  ürünün ne yaptığı, üç adımlı akış, özellikler ve yedi soruluk SSS, tam metin.
- [English — weekly meal planner and shopping list](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/en.html.md):
  the same ground in English, for "weekly meal planner", "shopping list app", "what to cook this week".
- [Support and FAQ](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/support.html.md): empty or repeating
  plans, shopping-list quantities, cancelling a subscription, restoring a purchase, data deletion.
- [En iyi yemek tarifi uygulamaları (2026)](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/en-iyi-yemek-tarifi-uygulamalari.html.md):
  eleven Turkish recipe apps ranked by TR rating count and product type, Maya last, conflict of
  interest disclosed. Turkish.
- [Maya vs Nefis Yemek Tarifleri](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/maya-vs-nefis-yemek-tarifleri.html.md):
  side by side with Turkey's largest recipe archive, explicit about where Nefis is better. Turkish.

## Legal

- [Gizlilik Politikası / Privacy policy](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/privacy.html.md):
  what stays on the device, what reaches Google Gemini, why photos are not stored, which
  identifiers exist, retention, and GDPR/KVKK rights. Turkish and English.
- [Kullanım Şartları / Terms of use](https://necatidogrul.github.io/maya-site/terms.html.md):
  subscription plans, the 3-day trial on the weekly plan only, auto-renewal, cancelling through
  Apple, refunds. Turkish and English.
